en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Bin Rabat, from Ibn Muskaan, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When the Penalty (Hadd) is established upon the thief, he is exiled for another city’.
